reason: Local conditional risk thresholds did not control the error and missed-event totals of the resulting schedule. Optimize the whole causal schedule by replay instead.
known_outcomes: All phase3-validation-v1 results on the original 128 tuning bays; initial pilot as recorded in phase1-evidence.json.
training_role: train_development only, Jan-Jun; no new reserved training reads
training_cohort: first 256 SHA256-hex-sorted BayIds under masters-parking-C3-training-v1: among primary training windows
fit: deterministic coordinate search of a context-to-pause table, starting at fixed60, at most 2 sweeps
contexts: same 48 sampled-state/time-of-day/observed-run contexts as C2; no true transition age
objective: C/C60 + lambda_F*F/F60 + lambda_O*O/O60; reject any policy with training M60>0. Lexicographic ties prefer smaller departure from fixed60.
selection: original 128 development bays, 10 common start phases; require training and tuning F/O/M60 no worse than fixed60; minimize calls then F/O then numeric parameters. Otherwise fixed60 fallback.
fresh_development_check: 512 primary-validation bays excluding the original 128 and every previously read pilot-prefix BayId; SHA256 order with masters-parking-C3-check-v1:; only chosen rules evaluated, no retuning after check.
sensitivity_check: chosen rules on all windows >=1 day of those same 512 bays, including primary windows; report separately
comparators: fixed60, old C2 resource1440 point, S2_1440 and S2_2880, original state-only strict selection; matched reference and all metrics preserved
novelty: Direct policy search and constrained objectives are established concepts. C3 is a candidate scheduling modification, not a claim of a new general optimizer or a proven world-first method.
